delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 5,000,000 within 30 days after both parties execute this Agreement. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
